members.name: Pretty Rajkumari
members.bio: Pretty Rajkumari is a final-year Psychology undergraduate at University of Delhi, with a minor in Human Resources Management. Her academic interests lie in research and Clinical Neuropsychology, with a particular focus on the impact of external factors such as social media on personality, self-identity and neurodevelopment using data-driven approaches such as brain imaging and data analysis. Alongside her studies, she has served as the Student Coordinator aka President and General Secretary of the North East Society at her college. At MitSna Foundation, she works as a Human Resources Assistant, coordinating the executive team, managing member onboarding and renewals, and organizing talks and community events. She is dedicated to supporting youth mental health and helping individuals reach their fullest potential. Outside of work and academics, you will find her engaged in puzzles and board games, reflecting and mostly giggling upon her non-fiction rom-com series and jamming her life out every chance she gets. An introverted extrovert, she brings both focus and warmth to every space she enters.
